122871: Kumatetsu is a potential successor to the throne of the Beast Kingdom. He has to choose someone to be his apprentice and he ends up choosing a human boy named Ren (and later names him Kyuuta).
122894: A young boy who runs away from home and ends up accidentally going to the beast world. He meets a beast named Kumatetsu, who is a potential candidate to become lord of the beast world. Kumatetsu ends up making Ren his apprentice and later names him Kyuuta.
131777: Iouzan is a father of two sons and a potential successor to the throne of the beast world.
131779: Kaede is a kind girl who meets Ren in the human world. Humbled by his kindness, yet baffled by his horrible Japanese, she offered to tutor him for free and they became good friends.
251757: Chiko is a strange beast that Ren finds. He will follow him to Jûtengai
